chunks: Whether you say a thing secretly or openly, He knows the innermost secrets of your hearts.

key_terms.ذَاتِ الصُّدُورِ: the inner essence/secrets of the chests/hearts

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He knows what is in the breasts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Ilm al-Ghayb* (Knowledge of the Unseen) as an attribute of Allah, affirming that He perceives both the audible words and the silent intentions of the heart. It serves as a spiritual reminder for believers to maintain sincerity (*ikhlas*) in all states, knowing that divine scrutiny encompasses the innermost secrets (*dhat al-sudur*) as thoroughly as public declarations.
